name: Ink Supplies
summary: In Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton needs fresh ink for his work as a monastic scribe. He sends you east to Lakeshire for Rethban ore, the mineral his fast-drying ink requires.

sections.title: A Scribe's Formula
sections.body: Brother Paxton takes pride in his craft and uses a special ink for important writings such as The Stresses of Iron. His recipe dries quickly and resists smearing, but the ink can dry in its pot if left too long. To make more, he needs raw Rethban iron ore, mined in the rocky Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Lakeshire has little room for a distant scribe’s request. Foreman Oslow oversees laborers busy strengthening barricades, rebuilding ruined structures, and defending the town from ongoing Blackrock orc raids. With no workers to spare for mining, travelers must seek the ore in the perilous Rethban Caverns themselves.

faq.q: Why does Brother Paxton need iron ore for ink?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton needs Rethban iron ore to make his special ink. Ground ore supplies the mineral pigment and setting qualities that give the ink its quick-drying, smear-proof script.
Foreman Oslow oversees civic construction and repairs in Lakeshire. With Blackrock orcs pressing the town, he directs its rebuilding and fortification.

faq.q: Where does Brother Paxton send you?
aliases: where do i go for ink supplies
faq.answer: Paxton sends you east from Elwynn Forest to Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains, to find Foreman Oslow.

faq.q: Why won't Foreman Oslow just give you the ore?
faq.answer: Blackrock orc attacks keep Lakeshire under pressure. Oslow’s workers are occupied repairing damaged buildings and fortifying the town, with no hands free to mine.

faq.q: What book is Brother Paxton attempting to copy?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton is copying The Stresses of Iron. His work stopped when his previous batch of quick-drying ink solidified in its container.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Foreman Oslow?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow tells you to gather Rethban iron ore yourself in the dangerous Rethban Caverns, north of Lake Everstill.

angles.text: As a priest, you can help the clergy with their scholarly work. Brother Paxton’s errand follows Brother Kristoff’s sermon on the Fortitude of the Spirit.
As a miner, you can seek Rethban iron ore, found high in the crags of Redridge.
As an Alliance traveler, you see the contrast between Northshire Abbey’s quiet seclusion and the violence threatening Lakeshire.
